newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Schulman EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Schulman EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it is reducing its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for A. Schulman Inc to $1.45 a share from $1.50, which compares with the recent consensus of $1.43. Its fiscal 1998 estimate remains $1.70.
-- Schulman, a polymer compounder and distributor, reported fiscal first quarter 1997 earnings of $0.32, up from $0.23 a year ago, and roughly in line with EVEREN's $0.33 estimate.
-- EVEREN said it cut its fiscal 1997 estimate due to marign pressure in the North American automotive market and reduced assumptions on first half revenue growth.
-- Price targets continue to be $25 a share for six months and $31 for 18-months.
-- EVEREN retains its near-term market perform and long-term outperform ratings.
